stories.title: Adani Ports to acquire European liquid storage operator for 2.56 billion euros
stories.summary: Adani Ports and Special Economic Zone Ltd has agreed to acquire Netherlands-based Evos B.V. for 2.56 billion euros in an all-cash deal. The acquisition is valued at 11.7 times the company's projected 2025 EBITDA. This marks the Indian operator's first major entry into the European liquid storage sector.

stories.title: Bharti Airtel revenue grows as premiumization strategy continues
stories.summary: Bharti Airtel reported a 16.7 percent year-on-year rise in consolidated revenue to 60,878 crore rupees, exceeding Bloomberg estimates. While Ebitda grew 18 percent, net profit reached 8,887.5 crore rupees, missing the consensus estimate of 9,293 crore rupees. The company attributed the performance to higher customer spending and postpaid additions.

stories.title: LG Electronics India profit rises 25.7 percent
stories.summary: LG Electronics India posted a net profit of 489.3 crore rupees for the September quarter, a 25.7 percent increase over the previous year. Revenue grew 19.5 percent to 7,380 crore rupees. Management credited the results to rising disposable incomes and a growing aspiration for premium consumer durables.

stories.title: Bharti Airtel reports 24 percent profit increase
stories.summary: Bharti Airtel reported a 24 percent increase in consolidated profit to 10,710 crore rupees for the quarter ended September 2026. Consolidated revenue from operations rose 16.7 percent to 60,877.5 crore rupees. India mobile average revenue per user improved to 271 rupees from 256 rupees a year ago.

stories.title: Mahindra and Mahindra profit rises 25 percent
stories.summary: Mahindra and Mahindra reported a 25 percent year-on-year rise in consolidated net profit to 4,588 crore rupees for the second quarter. Revenue grew 25 percent to 57,553 crore rupees. The automotive segment served as the primary growth driver, with SUV volumes increasing 26 percent during the period.

stories.title: Enforcement Directorate attaches 510 crore rupees in Reliance Anil Ambani Group assets
stories.summary: The Enforcement Directorate has attached 510.17 crore rupees in assets belonging to the Reliance Anil Ambani Group as part of investigations into alleged bank fraud. The seizure includes two private aircraft, six plots of land, and an office property in Maharashtra. The group has not commented.

stories.title: Apollo Hospitals profit grows 32 percent
stories.summary: Apollo Hospitals Enterprise Ltd reported a 32 percent year-on-year growth in consolidated net profit to 630 crore rupees for the quarter ended September 2026. Revenue grew 23 percent to 7,615 crore rupees. Hospital occupancy reached 73 percent, compared to 69 percent in the same period last year.

stories.title: Mahindra and Mahindra profit rises on automotive growth
stories.summary: Mahindra and Mahindra reported a 25 percent year-on-year rise in consolidated profit to 4,588 crore rupees for the second quarter. Revenue grew 25 percent to 57,553 crore rupees. While the automotive business saw profit jump 55 percent, the farm business faced lower sales amid margin pressure.

stories.title: Reliance Industries to begin underground coal gasification in Andhra Pradesh
stories.summary: Reliance Industries is set to begin exploration for an underground coal gasification project in Andhra Pradesh. The company aims to complete a pilot by mid-2028. The process converts coal into synthetic gas directly within underground seams, a method the company describes as a revolutionary approach to coal utilisation.

stories.title: LG Electronics India profit rises to 489 crore rupees
stories.summary: LG Electronics India reported a 25.7 percent rise in second-quarter profit to 489 crore rupees. Revenue increased 19.5 percent to 7,380 crore rupees, driven by a 21 percent sales increase in its home appliances and air solutions segment. The company cited rising disposable incomes for the performance.

stories.title: CERT-In flags security vulnerabilities in Tata Motors apps
stories.summary: The Indian Computer Emergency Response Team has identified security vulnerabilities in Tata Motors' iRA 2.0 and iRA.ev applications. The flaws could allow unauthorized access to sensitive information, user impersonation, and modification of application data. The agency issued an advisory regarding the risks to connected vehicle users.

stories.title: FSSAI accuses PepsiCo of misleading consumers on energy drinks
stories.summary: The Food Safety and Standards Authority of India has told the Delhi High Court that PepsiCo markets Sting and Adrenaline Rush as energy drinks despite the absence of prescribed standards for the category. The regulator argued the marketing misleads consumers. PepsiCo is currently defending its manufacturing and marketing practices.

stories.title: Sensex rallies 2,009 points as markets extend winning streak
stories.summary: The BSE Sensex rose 2,008.61 points to settle at 79,310.01 on Thursday, marking a 2.60 percent gain. The rally followed a decline in crude oil prices and investor optimism regarding the US midterm election results. The NSE Nifty also gained 576 points, closing at 24,536.60.

stories.title: Market capitalization crosses 500 lakh crore rupees
stories.summary: Benchmark indices extended their rally for a sixth consecutive session, with the Sensex reclaiming its August 3 closing level. The surge added nearly 8 lakh crore rupees to market capitalization in a single session, pushing the combined value of BSE-listed companies above 500 lakh crore rupees for the first time.

stories.title: Sensex gains 2,009 points in broad market rally
stories.summary: The BSE Sensex climbed 2,008.61 points to close at 79,310.01 on Thursday, while the NSE Nifty gained 576 points. The rally was supported by foreign fund inflows and global market performance. Investor sentiment improved following the US midterm election results and a sharp fall in crude oil prices.

stories.title: Financials and autos lead market rally
stories.summary: Indian shares posted their biggest gain in seven months on Thursday, with the Sensex and Nifty both rising 2.4 percent. The indices have surged over 8 percent in six sessions. Sectoral indices ended in the green, with the Nifty 100 emerging as the top gainer.

stories.title: Investor wealth increases by 29 lakh crore rupees
stories.summary: The total market capitalization of BSE-listed companies increased by 8.11 lakh crore rupees on Thursday, bringing the six-day gain in notional investor wealth to 28.92 lakh crore rupees. Analysts attributed the momentum to the US midterm election verdict and hopes for a more restrained policy environment in Washington.

stories.title: Sensex closes 2,009 points higher
stories.summary: The BSE Sensex surged 2,008.61 points to 79,310.01 on Thursday, while the Nifty 50 settled at 24,536.60. The rally was supported by sustained foreign institutional investor buying, a decline in crude oil prices, and positive global cues following the US midterm election results.

stories.summary: Benchmark indices extended their winning streak to a sixth consecutive session on November 5, marking their longest rally since November 2025. stories.title: Fairfax India invests in IIFL Capital
stories.summary: Fairfax India Holdings Corporation has acquired an additional 11.22 percent stake in IIFL Capital for 2,000 crore rupees. The company allotted over 57 million shares to the investor on November 4, 2026. The investment brings Fairfax India's total stake in the firm to 38 percent.

stories.summary: Adani Ports and Special Economic Zone has agreed to acquire 100 percent of Netherlands-based Evos for 2.56 billion euros. The all-cash deal values the liquid storage operator at 11.7 times its 2025 EBITDA. The company says this marks its first major entry into the European liquid storage sector.

stories.title: IPCA Laboratories reports profit growth
stories.summary: IPCA Laboratories reported a 32.5 percent year-on-year increase in net profit to 375 crore rupees for the September quarter. Revenue grew 13.8 percent to 2,910 crore rupees, while EBITDA margins expanded to 23 percent. The company attributed the performance to export growth and improved operating margins.

stories.title: Everstone AMC secures 1,700 crore rupees
stories.summary: Everstone AMC has secured 1,700 crore rupees in the first close of its new private equity fund. The fund reached the milestone within three months of launch, drawing commitments from family offices and non-resident Indians. It plans to focus on mid-market Indian companies through control-oriented growth strategies.

stories.title: Tata Iveco Acquisition Strengthens India-Italy Ties
stories.summary: Tata Sons chairman N Chandrasekaran met Italian Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni at Palazzo Chigi in Rome, with Tata Motors’ acquisition of a controlling stake in Italian commercial vehicle maker Iveco Group at the centre of discussions. The meeting comes as India and Italy seek to

stories.title: Tata Motors discusses Iveco strategy with Italian leadership
stories.summary: Tata Sons chairman N Chandrasekaran met with Italian Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni to discuss the group's strategy following Tata Motors' acquisition of an 89.42 percent stake in Iveco Group. The deal was valued at nearly 3.43 billion euros. The meeting highlights growing industrial collaboration between the two countries.

stories.title: IRB Infrastructure reports profit jump
stories.summary: IRB Infrastructure Developers reported an 84 percent rise in net profit for the September quarter. The company also unlocked 2,744 crore rupees through the transfer of two highway assets to its Infrastructure Investment Trust. EBITDA margins improved to 45.3 percent during the period.

stories.title: Investors circle STT GDC India stake
stories.summary: Brookfield and Macquarie are reportedly in discussions to acquire a stake in ST Telemedia Global Data Centres India. Shareholders led by KKR aim to conclude a transaction by the end of January. Non-binding offers are expected between late November and mid-December. The sale process is currently underway.

stories.title: CCI approves Aditya Birla Renewables deal
stories.summary: The Competition Commission of India has approved the acquisition of Solenergi Power by Aditya Birla Renewables for an enterprise value of 172 billion rupees. The 1.8 billion dollar deal involves acquiring 100 percent of the company from Shell Overseas Investment. It aims to create a large renewable platform.

stories.title: Diwali cleaning should include your finances
stories.summary: Diwali cleaning is about decluttering homes and getting rid of things you no longer need. The exercise should extend to your finances too, as people accumulate multiple bank accounts and insurance policies over time. Reviewing these can help reduce unnecessary costs and identify forgotten money.

stories.title: Nine years of India’s GST reform
stories.summary: What began as a bumpy, ambitious experiment in tax restructuring has become a major fiscal reform for the Modi government. Nine years on, GST is a central part of India’s public finances. Monthly gross collections have crossed Rs 2 lakh crore, and the taxpayer base has expanded substantially.

stories.title: Marine mammal strandings recorded along Indian coast
stories.summary: The ICAR-Central Marine Fisheries Research Institute documented 161 marine mammal stranding cases along the Indian coast during 2024 to 2025. Goa accounted for the highest number at 113. Humpback dolphins accounted for the highest number of strandings, followed by Indo-Pacific species. The ocean remains a complex place.

stories.title: Kerala GST growth outpaces national average
stories.summary: Kerala generated 3,689 crore in GST revenue in October, a 27 per cent increase compared to the previous year. National GST revenue grew by 12.8 per cent over the same period. The surge was primarily driven by post-settlement revenue, which includes both the State and Integrated GST.

stories.title: Small savings schemes for senior citizens
stories.summary: National Savings Certificate and Senior Citizens Savings Scheme offer predictable returns and sovereign backing. They differ in interest rates, payout frequency, investment limits, and tax treatment. Having a clear understanding of the features can help investors make wise choices. Retirement planning remains a game of small margins.

stories.title: Food costs dominate rural household spending
stories.summary: Food continues to account for more than half of rural household consumption expenditure, with households allocating 53.5% of monthly spending towards it. The share has remained within a narrow range of 52.4% to 56.7% since September 2024. Inflation concerns continue to gather pace in the countryside.

stories.title: Eighth Pay Commission status update
stories.summary: The 8th Central Pay Commission was constituted on 3 November 2025. While the official implementation date has not been announced, 1 January 2026 is widely anticipated as the date the new pay scales will come into effect. There are various stages to pass before revised salaries are paid.

stories.title: EPFO reminds pensioners to submit life certificates
stories.summary: Pensioners must submit their Jeevan Pramaan, or Digital Life Certificate, to ensure the continuation of their pension. The EPFO suggests using face authentication via the UMANG app or visiting a local office. The process is described as easier than ever, provided the technology cooperates with the user.

stories.title: Google expands voluntary buyout offers
stories.summary: Google confirmed it began offering voluntary exit packages in June to employees in Canada, France, Germany, Japan and Switzerland. The company is looking to rein in rising costs amid heavy spending on artificial intelligence. The number of employees who accepted the latest round of offers remains undetermined.

stories.title: Railways operates 18,000 special trains
stories.summary: Indian Railways has ramped up preparations for the festive season, with around 18,000 special trains being operated this year. Upgraded passenger facilities are in place at congested stations including New Delhi and Anand Vihar. Holding areas can now accommodate around 20,000 passengers each at specific stations.

stories.title: Financial security versus following your passion
stories.summary: The advice to follow your passion is described as a high-stakes gamble in an economy defined by intense competition and limited social security. Data points to a more resilient approach of chasing financial security first. Ambition is easier to fund when the rent is already paid.

stories.title: Government clarifies GPF payout rules
stories.summary: The Ministry of Personnel, Public Grievances and Pensions has clarified who is entitled to the General Provident Fund balance of a deceased employee. The memorandum aims to prevent prolonged legal disputes by defining family and rules for payments. The rules are now set for the deceased.
